description: Caltrans Vista Points is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Vista points are informal pullouts where motorists can safely view scenery or park and relax. They do not include rest rooms. Vista points may have facilities including walkways, interpretive displays, railings, benches, interpretive information, trash receptacles, monuments and other pedestrian facilities that are accessible to all persons. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California, Caltrans, Division of Maintenance, Right of Way, Roadside, Vista point, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData. The bounding box given is -124.1990,32.8367,-116.4008,41.9968. The hub shows 2020-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public – data could be made publicly available without restrictions.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
